inventory.rule: Shared rule for the total delta: it exists only when EVERY selected area (all areas without --area, X with --area X) has a baseline row, and then equals the sum of the selected-area deltas. A missing row for any selected area means no total delta, whatever --area was. This replaces the earlier comparison against baseline.total, which is only valid when the baseline and the run cover the same areas.
